create_Trajectory: create a Trajectory instance with an environment, horizon length, and random seed
run_Trajectory_update: run the Trajectory update method to accept a set of trajectories and update the solution
animate_Trajectory_rollout: animate a Trajectory rollout starting from a given timestep with a custom action sequence
animate_Trajectory_result: animate the full Trajectory result by replaying the optimized action sequence
generate_frame: generate an offscreen render frame from a Mujoco or DMC environment at a given timestep
